Step 1: Europe/Paris in 1258 used local mean time based on longitude, roughly UTC+0:09:21 (Paris meridian ≈ 2°20′E).  
Step 2: 9 PM UTC = 21:00 UTC.  
Step 3: Add 9 minutes 21 seconds → 21:09:21 local mean time in Paris.  
Step 4: Date remains March 2, 1258 (no modern DST or zone shifts).  

FINAL_ANSWER: 21:09
